prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Controls Quick Reference Screen: Adds a dedicated companion control guide screen after home intro to explicitly demonstrate how to move, chat with, and hide desktop pets before completing onboarding.
   config: {"home_intro": {"headline": "Welcome Your Companion to the Desktop"}, "new_controls_card": {"headline": "How to Interact with Your Pet", "body": "Drag your pet anywhere on screen, double-click to chat, or right-click to access quick tray settings.", "layout": "card", "components": [{"type": "text", "text": "Right-click pet for menu controls & hide option", "style": "highlight"}]}}
1: [adoption, redesign] Adoption Certificate Signature and Persona Redesign: Rebuilds the adoption certificate layout into a full-bleed official adoption record featuring a verified companion badge and formal pet naming prompt.
   config: {"adoption_certificate": {"layout": "full_bleed", "headline": "Official Desktop Companion Certificate", "body": "Give your new desktop companion a name to finalize your official adoption record.", "components": [{"type": "badge", "label": "Official Adoption Seal", "style": "playful"}]}}
2: [sign_in, reorder] Post-Adoption Certificate Sign-In Order Shift: Moves sign-in directly after adoption certificate completion so users secure their account right after bonding with and naming their pet.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "sign_in", "waiting", "home_intro"], "sign_in": {"headline": "Save Your Adoption Record", "body": "Sign in to save your newly created pet to your account and prevent progress loss."}}
3: [choose_path, new_flow] Interactive Behavior Preview Sub-Flow: Inserts a dynamic behavior preview screen prior to path selection so users can watch desktop pets act out different daily routines before committing.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "new_path_preview", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"], "new_path_preview": {"headline": "Preview Desktop Pet Life", "body": "Watch how companions roam your screen, react to open apps, and rest alongside your work.", "layout": "two_column", "components": [{"type": "video", "asset": "asset:preview_video", "style": "rounded"}]}}
4: [sign_in, copy] Existing Account Pet Sync Copy: Updates sign-in headline and body copy to explicitly confirm that logging in restores previously adopted pets.
   config: {"sign_in": {"headline": "Sign In to Restore Existing Pets", "body": "Already adopted a pet? Sign into your account to immediately restore your desktop companion and save current progress.", "hint": "Your account keeps your companions safely synced across sessions."}}
5: [home, wait_info] Live Asset Generation Stage Progress Indicator: Configures the waiting screen into a structured stage layout with step progress indicators and estimated render times while pet assets construct.
   config: {"waiting": {"layout": "stage", "headline": "Building Your Desktop Pet", "body": "Rendering custom animations and configuring desktop interactions...", "show_progress": true, "show_time_estimate": true, "tip_delay_seconds": 15}}
6: [adoption, layout] Two-Column Pick Friend Persona Layout: Replaces the pick_friend layout with a two-column display separating visual pet artwork from personality trait details.
   config: {"pick_friend": {"layout": "two_column", "headline": "Choose Your Companion Persona", "body": "Select a pet visual style on the left and review personality traits on the right.", "show_step_counter": true}}
7: [adoption, hint] Custom Photo Upload Spec Validation Hint: Adds explicit lighting and photo format hints to the upload_photos screen to guide custom pet image creation.
   config: {"upload_photos": {"hint": "For best results, upload a clear front-facing photo with good lighting and contrast.", "components": [{"type": "badge", "label": "Supported formats: PNG, JPG under 10MB", "style": "subtle"}]}}
8: [home, notification] Background Generation Notification Toggle: Enables a background desktop notification prompt on the waiting screen so users can minimize the app during long pet asset builds.
   config: {"waiting": {"notify_when_ready": true, "hint": "You can safely minimize this window. We will send a desktop alert as soon as your pet is ready!"}}
9: [choose_path, incentive] Starter Desktop Accessory Choice Incentive: Displays a free starter item badge on choose_path screens rewarding users for starting their companion journey.
   config: {"choose_path": {"headline": "Pick a Path & Claim Free Desktop Toy", "body": "Choose your pet path today to unlock an exclusive starter toy accessory for your desktop companion.", "components": [{"type": "badge", "label": "Free Starter Accessory Included", "style": "highlight"}]}}

verdicts.reason: Adding a controls guide screen after home_intro is explicitly allowed under Rule 4.
Redesigns the adoption certificate while preserving the official adoption seal job requirement.
Moving sign-in after adoption certificate is explicitly permitted under Rule 4.
Inserting a behavior preview screen within onboarding is allowed by Rule 4.
Updating sign-in copy without changing pricing or mechanics is allowed.
Adding stage indicators and real wait time estimates on the waiting screen is permitted.
Redesigning pick_friend into a two-column layout preserves its core job.
Adding photo upload guidelines to upload_photos is a valid onboarding enhancement.
Adding a background desktop notification toggle on the waiting screen is allowed.
Onboarding copy mentions free extras ('Free Desktop Toy' / 'Free Starter Accessory Included'), which violates Rule 3.
